baseline.method: Minimally corrected original Fourier Biot-Savart inverse, full padded current, no actual truth

nrmse_definition: No DR-NRMSE: relative_l2_component = norm(estimate-reference)/norm(reference), evaluated separately for signed jx and jy. This is a numerical standard-method reference, not actual truth.
physical_definition: filtered_forward_residual = norm(F(J)-H*FFT(padded_flux) with DC0)/norm(H*FFT(padded_flux) with DC0); divergence_ratio = norm(kx*Jx+ky*Jy)/norm(K*sqrt(abs(Jx)^2+abs(Jy)^2)); dc_ratio = norm(component_means)/RMS(all components).
threshold_provenance: Frozen before local extraction in private oracle_record.json. Corrected original independent repeat bit identical; forward1.92e-16, divergence2.00e-17, imaginary8.54e-16. Nonzero tolerances allow numerical portability while retaining both spatial components and physical constraints.
